caption: Garcia v. Missing Sock Laundry Service LLC
citation_line: Garcia v. Missing Sock Laundry Service LLC, No. 2:24-cv-08045, ECF No. 38 (D.N.J. June 24, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Approved a $125,000 FLSA settlement for laundry workers, including a general release supported by separately identified consideration and a one-third fee award; the agreement contained no confidentiality or non-disparagement clause.
qualification_rationale: A compact settlement-approval model addressing bona fide dispute, installment-payment risk, releases, public-policy concerns, and percentage fees.
appellate_posture_note: Final consent disposition of the settling parties' claims; no substantive appellate review identified.
